name: app-hand-held-health-updates-app-with-green-cards-and-tag-pills
title: Health Updates App in Dark Hands
whatItIs: A pale green-yellow gradient cover with dark hands holding a phone showing a Health Updates screen with a glass header, a green specialty card, a consultation card and a floating green button, with brand and discipline pills in the bottom corners.
whatItMeans: Soft green gradients feel fresh and healing, and dark hands make a strong contrast to the pale UI.
techniques: Green accent cards inside a white UI
Rounded pill labels in the corners
Finger about to tap the screen

vocabulary.definition: A translucent header showing a blurred image.
Rounded labels in the corners of a cover.
A card representing a category of care.
